species: The selected protein spots were manually excised from gels stained with Coomassie Brilliant Blue G250 (Merck) and identified by Liquid Chromatography–Mass Spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) at the University of the Basque Country (UPV/EHU) proteomics service, SGIker, following the method described by Areitio et al., with some modifications.
cell_type: Candidozyma auris (Candida auris) is an emerging pathogenic yeast of global concern due to its persistence on abiotic and biotic surfaces and the difficulty of treating the severe infections it causes, which are frequently associated with high mortality rates because of its extensive antifungal resistance.

sample_source: Total protein and CWAP were extracted independently from C. auris CECT 13225, following the methodologies described by Areitio et al. and Pitarch et al., respectively.
